Messages.Author: Charles_Bronson
Messages.Body:
Hi!

I'm pretty sure I already know the answer, but i'm asking here just to be safe

Terror Frenzy
Frenzy.
[ani] Only usable before range is determined on the first round. During this combat, the opposing minion cannot use maneuvers to maneuver to close range, cannot use presses to continue combat and cannot use equipment.

[ANI] Only usable before range is determined. Combat cards cost the opposing vampire an additional blood this combat. A vampire may play only one Terror Frenzy at superior each combat.

The old text of terror frenzy was "burns blood". So, I remember we allowed vampires with no blood affected by the superior card text to throw combat cards as normal.

The new text means empty vampires cannot play the blood cost therefore they cannot play combat cards (unless they are dragos or have some cost reducing power).

Is that correct?
thanks

I am death.
Paul Kersey, Death Wish

> [ani] Only usable before range is determined on the first round. During this combat, the opposing minion cannot use maneuvers to maneuver to close range, cannot use presses to continue combat and cannot use equipment.

> [ANI] Only usable before range is determined. Combat cards cost the opposing vampire an additional blood this combat. A vampire may play only one Terror Frenzy at superior each combat.
>
> The old text of terror frenzy was "burns blood". So, I remember we allowed vampires with no blood affected by the superior card text to throw combat cards as normal.
>
> The new text means empty vampires cannot play the blood cost therefore they cannot play combat cards (unless they are dragos or have some cost reducing power).
>
> Is that correct?
> thanks
>
The "new" cardtext (rather latest cardtext, since 2007) states the cards cost 1 additional blood. You can't play cards that you can't pay, so an empty vampire cannot pay a card that costs blood.
